label: Preference-independent epistemic reason from a constitutive aim
description: Conditional analyst argument, attribution deferred: the existing thin-to-ordinary result yields an ordinary-role reason; inside the goal-relative structure, an aim present in every supplied preference alternative gives that reason force at each one. The goal-relative form is kept; preference independence comes from treating the aim as belonging to belief rather than to desire. It conflicts with an indifference alternative for the same aim. Establishes no premise.
